brief.headline: Cut our laminate price by 76% to match the ₹250.00/KG we already pay Silk Polypack — we're paying ₹1067.36/KG today and the open market quotes ₹205–305/kg for similar sachets.

priceAsk.summary: Move our LAMINATE price from ₹1067.36/KG down to ₹250.00/KG, the price we already pay Silk Polypack for the same material.
priceAsk.target: ₹250.00/KG — saves us ₹58850 a year on this one item.
priceAsk.basis: Today we pay them ₹1067.36/KG, a 326.9% gap over our best price. The open market quotes pharma/ORS sachet laminate at ₹205–305/kg typical ₹250/kg, so our Silk price sits at the top of the fair band. Even the import baseline for raw BOPET film is only 171.60 ₹/kg, well below what we're paying Huhtamaki for finished laminate.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 Days After Receipt — no reason to tighten terms when the price gap is this wide.

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki India is a listed company but publishes no financials we can see, so we can't tell how healthy or tight they are. Our ₹76850 annual spend is tiny for a listed flexible-packaging firm — we have zero must-keep leverage. That means we build our case purely on the price gap: we already buy the same laminate elsewhere at ₹250.00/KG, the open market quotes ₹205–305/kg, and we have two strong listed converters (UFLEX and the same Huhtamaki) plus Constantia and Amcor ready as second sources. Walk in with the Silk Polypack invoice and the market quote, not a hard squeeze.

evidence.point: We pay Huhtamaki ₹1067.36/KG for LAMINATE — over four times our best price.
The open market quotes pharma/ORS sachet laminate at ₹250/kg typical, inside a ₹205–305/kg fair band.
Even raw imported BOPET film lands at only ₹171.60/kg — far below what we pay for finished laminate.
Closing this gap saves us ₹58850 a year on one SKU.
Our total annual spend with them is only ₹76850 — a drop for a listed converter.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd (listed)
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant — both film substrate AND conversion; can second-source laminate sachets at scale.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter — pharma blister/sachet laminates; strong second-source, revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health D (31/100) so financially visible.

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Amcor's India arm — high-end pharma laminates; premium but very reliable second source.

risks: Huhtamaki publishes no financials — we can't read their health or cash position, so don't assume they're flush or distressed.
Our ₹76850 spend is trivial to them — they may simply decline to match Silk Polypack and walk away; have UFLEX or Constantia quoted before this meeting.
If they claim Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG is for a different spec or simpler construction, ask for a line-item breakdown of their ₹1067.36/KG cost to prove the difference.

The market quotes ₹205–305/kg; if they won't move below ₹305/kg, qualify one of the film-maker leads (Polyplex, Ester, Jindal) to verify that even substrate plus normal conversion margins can't justify ₹1067/kg.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to close the gap on our LAMINATE price — today we pay you ₹1067 a kilo, but we buy the same material from Silk Polypack at ₹250, and the open market quotes ₹205–305 for pharma sachets, so let's find a way to that ₹250 benchmark.
